name: 3C 300.1 (Hubble)
blurb: 3C 300.1, a powerful radio galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: 3c3001-hubble
story: One of the most powerful radio galaxies of its era, caught in what astronomers call the Bright Ages. Hubble surveyed galaxies like this one, thought to be forebears of the giant elliptical galaxies that dominate galaxy clusters, to learn whether an active nucleus kindles or quenches the birth of stars.

claims.text: 3C 300.1 is a radio galaxy in the 3C high-redshift Hubble survey
3C300.1 was a target of Hubble program 13023 on powerful 3C radio sources
The program targeted the most powerful radio galaxies at their redshifts
The program is titled for the 'Bright Ages'
Such galaxies are thought to be progenitors of the most massive cluster ellipticals
The program asks how the active nucleus affects star formation
